item.title: Is the stock market open for Thanksgiving? The answer might surprise you.
item.description: The answer to the question of whether the stock market is open on Thanksgiving isn’t a simple yes or no, as the major exchanges are closed, but trading of equity futures is open for part of the day.
item.dc:creator: Tomi Kilgore

item.title: We are living in perilous times if Nvidia’s Jensen Huang dictates your 401(k) balance
item.description: Why did a futurist with Huang’s prescient vision build a company where all roads lead to him?
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: Why this stock-market selloff is probably going to get worse before it gets better
item.description: Monday’s rally helped to paper over deeper issues that must be resolved before a durable bottom can arrive.
item.dc:creator: Joseph Adinolfi

item.title: A 66-year-old nurse is facing down retirement with just $500 saved. Who’s to blame?
item.description: “Retirement is a financial status, not an age.”

item.title: I’m in my 70s and buying a new BMW X1. Should I put my only son on the title?

item.title: I’ve been married for 58 years. It’s ‘our’ money, not ‘his’ and ‘hers.’ Why do so many couples keep their finances separate?

item.title: I hate that Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia, but I love what it’s done for my 401(k). Am I a hypocrite?
item.description: Doing nothing and maintaining an even temperament is often the work of gods.

item.title: Oracle, CoreWeave and other tech stocks bounce back after selloff
item.description: Oracle, CoreWeave and other technology stocks bounced back from early losses on Wednesday, after what appeared to be a major selloff eased ahead of the market’s close.
item.dc:creator: William Gavin

item.title: Nvidia’s stock has given back a big chunk of Monday’s rally as dip buyers cash in
item.description: Based on where retail investors bought Nvidia shares on the dip last week, their gains are now nearly all gone, according to Vanda Research.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Pedone

item.title: Elon Musk and SpaceX to donate roughly $17.8 billion to ‘Trump accounts’
item.description: SpaceX to provide one newly issued Class A share to every active ‘Trump account,’ and CEO Musk will match that gift.
item.dc:creator: William Gavin
